result.rationale: These statements explicitly introduce a relative velocity β and an auxiliary 'moving' reference frame for galaxies (via metric-derived velocity and SR aberration/Doppler formulas), embodying the false premise that galaxies occupy a distinct frame requiring special-relativistic transformation rather than being comoving in FLRW.

EQUATION::2's analysis identifies the spurious covariant derivative term used to justify treating stationary galaxies as having relative velocity—the same flawed premise (wrong reference frame assumption) as the annotation, despite differing technical framing.
